storeInfo.name: Black N Gold Tavern
storeInfo.tagline: Classic American Tavern Fare with a Local Twist / Clásica Comida de Taberna Americana con un Toque Local

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Alitas de pollo crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa picante secreta de la casa, servidas con apio y aderezo de queso azul.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature house buffalo sauce, served with crisp celery and creamy blue cheese dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Pieles de papa horneadas y crujientes repletas de queso cheddar derretido, tocino ahumado y cebollino fresco, con crema agria.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy baked potato skins packed with melted cheddar cheese, smoky bacon, and fresh chives, served with sour cream.
Breaded mozzarella cheese sticks fried to golden perfection, served with warm house-made marinara dipping sauce.

products.nameEs: Nachos de la Casa con Queso
products.descriptionEn: Crispy tortilla chips piled high with melted cheese, black beans, jalapeños, pico de gallo, sour cream, and fresh guacamole.
Juicy Angus beef patty topped with aged cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, caramelized onions, and signature sauce on a toasted brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Pollo Crujiente Estilo Nashville
products.descriptionEn: Spicy crispy fried chicken breast topped with southern-style coleslaw and tangy pickles on a toasted brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Wrap de Pollo César a la Parrilla
products.descriptionEn: Grilled chicken strips, crisp romaine lettuce, shaved parmesan cheese, and creamy Caesar dressing wrapped in a flour tortilla.

products.nameEs: Pescado con Papas Fritas Estilo Taberna
products.descriptionEn: Fresh cod fillet dipped in our craft beer batter, fried golden and crispy. Served with french fries, tartar sauce, and lemon.

products.nameEs: Costillas BBQ Ahumadas a la Barbecue
products.descriptionEn: Tender pork ribs slow-smoked for hours, basted in sweet and tangy BBQ sauce, served with french fries and coleslaw.

products.nameEs: Macarrones con Queso y Tocino Gratinados
products.descriptionEn: Cavatappi pasta tossed in a rich three-cheese cream sauce, topped with crispy bacon bits and toasted breadcrumbs.
Draft IPA brewed right here in Connecticut, featuring bold citrus notes and a perfectly balanced hop finish.
Refreshing house-made lemonade infused with a sweet puree of fresh ripe raspberries.

products.descriptionEs: Pretzels suaves recién horneados servidos con nuestra salsa tibia de queso cheddar y IPA local.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly baked warm soft pretzels served with our warm local IPA cheddar cheese dip.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares empanizados ligeramente fritos, acompañados de rodajas de jalapeño y salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly fried breaded calamari tossed with jalapeño slices and served with homemade marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Mezcla cremosa de espinacas, alcachofas y quesos fundidos, servida con totopos de maíz crujientes.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy blend of spinach, artichokes, and melted cheeses, served with crispy warm corn tortilla chips.

products.descriptionEs: Floretes de coliflor empanizados, fritos y bañados en salsa búfala picante, con aderezo de queso azul.
products.descriptionEn: Breaded cauliflower florets fried and tossed in spicy buffalo sauce, served with blue cheese dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Brochetas de camarones jugosos salteados en mantequilla de ajo, hierbas finas y vino blanco.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy shrimp skewers sautéed in rich garlic butter, fine herbs, and a splash of white wine.

products.nameEs: Filete de Cerdo Estilo Nueva Inglaterra
products.descriptionEs: Gruesa chuleta de cerdo a la parrilla glaseada con maple de Connecticut, servida con puré de papas.
products.descriptionEn: Thick-cut grilled pork chop glazed with local Connecticut maple, served with garlic mashed potatoes.

products.descriptionEs: Hamburguesa a base de plantas con aguacate fresco, lechuga, tomate y mayonesa vegana en pan brioche.
products.descriptionEn: Plant-based patty topped with fresh avocado, lettuce, tomato, and vegan mayo on a toasted brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Roast Beef Au Jus
products.descriptionEs: Fino roast beef cortado en láminas con queso provolone fundido en pan baguette, servido con jugo de carne.
products.descriptionEn: Thinly sliced roast beef with melted provolone cheese on a toasted baguette, served with savory au jus.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo marinada a la parrilla con salsa de limón y alcaparras, acompañada de vegetales.
products.descriptionEn: Grilled marinated chicken breast topped with a lemon-caper herb sauce, served with seasonal vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Tortilla de trigo integral rellena de vegetales asados, hummus cremoso y espinacas frescas.
products.descriptionEn: Whole wheat tortilla stuffed with roasted seasonal vegetables, creamy hummus, and fresh spinach.

products.nameEs: Filete Ribeye Black N Gold (14 oz)
products.nameEn: Black N Gold Ribeye Steak (14 oz)
products.descriptionEs: Corte premium de ribeye a la parrilla, bañado en mantequilla de hierbas de la casa y papas fritas.
products.descriptionEn: Premium cut grilled ribeye steak topped with house herb compound butter, served with hand-cut fries.

products.nameEs: Salmón Glaseado con Miel y Mostaza
products.descriptionEs: Filete de salmón fresco horneado con glaseado de miel y mostaza antigua, sobre cama de arroz pilaf.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh baked salmon fillet with a sweet honey and whole-grain mustard glaze, served over wild rice pilaf.

products.nameEs: Pasta Cremosa con Camarones y Cajun
products.descriptionEs: Fettuccine en salsa cremosa de ajo y parmesano con camarones salteados al estilo cajun ligeramente picante.
products.descriptionEn: Fettuccine tossed in a rich garlic parmesan cream sauce topped with mildly spiced cajun shrimp.

products.descriptionEs: Costillas de res cocinadas a fuego lento durante horas en vino tinto, servidas con polenta cremosa.
products.descriptionEn: Beef short ribs slow-braised for hours in rich red wine reduction, served over creamy parmesan polenta.

products.descriptionEs: Tres tacos de pescado crujiente en tortillas de maíz con col morada rallada y salsa de chipotle y lima.
products.descriptionEn: Three crispy fish tacos in corn tortillas with shredded red cabbage, cilantro, and zesty chipotle-lime mayo.

products.descriptionEs: Refrescante mezcla de vodka artesanal, cerveza de jengibre picante y jugo de lima fresco en taza de cobre.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing blend of craft vodka, spicy ginger beer, and fresh lime juice served in a chilled copper mug.

products.nameEs: Limonada de Moras de la Casa
products.descriptionEs: Limonada natural recién exprimida endulzada con puré de moras silvestres y menta fresca.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed natural lemonade sweetened with wild blackberry puree and fresh garden mint leaves.

products.descriptionEs: Té negro clásico preparado diariamente, ligeramente endulzado y servido con rodaja de limón.
products.descriptionEn: Classic black iced tea brewed fresh daily, lightly sweetened and served over ice with a lemon wheel.

products.descriptionEs: Cerveza oscura artesanal de Connecticut con notas profundas de chocolate amargo y café tostado.
products.descriptionEn: Local Connecticut craft stout featuring deep notes of dark chocolate and roasted coffee beans.

products.descriptionEs: Tequila 100% agave, licor de naranja, jugo de lima fresco y rodajas de jalapeño con borde salado.
products.descriptionEn: 100% agave tequila, triple sec, fresh lime juice, and muddled jalapeños with a salted rim.

products.descriptionEs: Sidra de manzana dura artesanal de los huertos de Nueva Inglaterra, crujiente y refrescante.
products.descriptionEn: Artisanal hard apple cider sourced from New England orchards, crisp, dry, and refreshing.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas y podemos adaptar algunos platos para dietas sin gluten. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian options and can adapt certain dishes for gluten-free diets. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large groups?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones telefónicas para grupos. Llámenos con anticipación para coordinar.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and take phone reservations for groups. Please call ahead to coordinate.

faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con estacionamiento en el lote contiguo y también hay estacionamiento gratuito en la calle.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have an adjacent parking lot and free street parking is also available.
